_description: Honeywell PROD environment (domain named 'nucleusqa' but this IS the live production instance) — us-east-1. Fill ALL FILL_IN values before running deploy_alexa.py

_docs.__: One-liner per key: what uses it and why. Deploy script ignores all _-prefixed keys.
_docs.DEPLOY_TARGET: deploy_alexa.py reads this to confirm you're running the right script against the right config
_docs.ROLE_PREFIX: Prefix for all IAM execution role names (e.g. honeywell-alexa-start-role). Keep per-env to avoid collisions
_docs.ENV_LABEL: Human label used in deploy log output and HTML report filenames
_docs.AWS_REGION: Main region: 9 Lambdas, all DDB tables, KMS key, API Gateway all live here
_docs.ALEXA_FULFILLMENT_REGION: alexa_fulfillment deploys here (eu-west-1). Alexa Smart Home requires the endpoint Lambda to be in a supported region
_docs.API_GATEWAY_ID: Existing API Gateway REST API to attach Alexa routes to. Empty = script creates a new one
_docs.API_STAGE: API Gateway stage name (e.g. 'api'). Becomes the URL prefix: /api/alexa/...
_docs.API_BASE_URL: Full HTTPS base URL including stage. Used to build OAuth redirect URIs and CORS origins
_docs.COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID: User pool that issued the app's JWTs. alexa_fulfillment and skill_events validate tokens against its JWKS endpoint
_docs.COGNITO_REGION: Region of the pool above — used to construct the JWKS URL (cognito-idp.<region>.amazonaws.com/.../.well-known/jwks.json)
_docs.COGNITO_CLIENT_ID: Main mobile app client (Nucleus app). Used by Google Home OAuth proxy to exchange tokens. Not required for Alexa-only deploy
_docs.COGNITO_CLIENT_SECRET: Secret for COGNITO_CLIENT_ID above. Required only for GH token exchange; leave blank for Alexa-only deploy
_docs.COGNITO_HOSTED_UI_DOMAIN: Cognito Hosted UI domain. alexa_complete_app_to_app redirects the user here for Stage 2 login
_docs.COGNITO_ALEXA_CLIENT_ID: Dedicated Alexa app client in Cognito (digilux-alexa-client). Stage 2 Cognito auth uses this client, not the main app client
_docs.ALEXA_COGNITO_CALLBACK_URI: Redirect URI for Stage 2 Cognito login. MUST be added to COGNITO_ALEXA_CLIENT_ID's allowed callback URLs in Cognito console
_docs.ALEXA_SESSIONS_TABLE: DDB table for in-progress app-to-app linking sessions. Created by deploy script. TTL = ALEXA_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS
_docs.ALEXA_TOKENS_TABLE: DDB table storing LWA tokens + alexaLinked flag per Cognito user. Created by deploy script
_docs.ALEXA_PKCE_TABLE: DDB table for PKCE state during Stage 1 LWA flow. Created by deploy script. TTL = ALEXA_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS
_docs.GH_SESSIONS_TABLE: GH deep-link session table. Used by Google Home Lambdas only — not Alexa
_docs.GH_AUTH_CODES_TABLE: GH OAuth auth code table. Used by Google Home Lambdas only
_docs.GH_TOKENS_TABLE: Legacy GH token table (pre-192f612). No longer written to — kept so old records don't break anything
_docs.LWA_SECRET_ARN: Secrets Manager secret holding Amazon LWA client_id + client_secret. Used by all Lambdas that call Amazon's token/revoke endpoints
_docs.LWA_SECRET_REGION: Region where the LWA secret above is stored
_docs.KMS_KEY_ALIAS: KMS key alias for encrypting LWA access/refresh tokens stored in ALEXA_TOKENS_TABLE. Created by deploy script if not present
_docs.ALEXA_SKILL_ID: Alexa skill ID. Used in SMAPI API calls and in the Alexa resource policy principal condition for alexa_fulfillment
_docs.ALEXA_SKILL_STAGE: 'development' or 'live'. Controls which SMAPI endpoint + OAuth scope is used. Set to 'live' only after skill is published
_docs.ALEXA_REDIRECT_URI: OAuth redirect URI registered in Alexa Developer Console Account Linking. Amazon redirects here after user consent
_docs.ALEXA_REDIRECT_HOSTS: Allowed HTTPS hosts for alexa_server_callback to validate the redirect origin — prevents open-redirect attacks
_docs.SMAPI_LINKING_ENABLED: 'true'/'false'. Enables SMAPI skill-enablement call in Stage 2. Set 'false' temporarily if skill is not yet published and SMAPI returns 404
_docs.PKCE_STATE_SECRET_ARN: Secrets Manager secret for HMAC-signing PKCE state tokens. LEAVE BLANK — deploy script auto-creates it on first run, then writes the ARN back
_docs.PKCE_STATE_SECRET_REGION: Region where the PKCE state secret will be created
_docs.GOOGLE_SECRET_ARN: Secrets Manager secret with GH OAuth client credentials. Used by Google Home Lambdas only
_docs.GOOGLE_SECRET_REGION: Region of the GH OAuth secret
_docs.GOOGLE_AGENT_ID: Google Actions project/agent ID. Used by GH fulfillment and proactive reporting to identify which GH project to report to
_docs.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: Cognito GH app client ID. Google sends this in token requests so the token Lambda can identify the caller
_docs.GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI: Google's fixed OAuth redirect URI. Must match exactly what Google sends — any mismatch causes GH OAuth to fail
_docs.APP_DEEP_LINK_SCHEME: Custom URL scheme of the mobile app (e.g. com.honeywell.nucleus). Used to build the deep link back to the app after OAuth completes
_docs.APP_NAME: Human-readable app name. Shown in consent pages and log messages
_docs.DEVICE_MANUFACTURER: Manufacturer name returned in Alexa and GH device discovery responses
_docs.LOG_LEVEL: Python logging level (DEBUG/INFO/WARN). Set to DEBUG temporarily when troubleshooting
_docs.SESSION_TTL_SECONDS: TTL for GH OAuth session records in DDB (1800 = 30 min). After this the OAuth flow must restart
_docs.AUTH_CODE_TTL_SECONDS: TTL for GH auth code records (900 = 15 min). Google must exchange the code before it expires
_docs.ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS: TTL for GH access token records
_docs.REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS: TTL for GH refresh token records (15552000 = 180 days)
_docs.ALEXA_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS: TTL for Alexa linking session records in ALEXA_SESSIONS_TABLE (600 = 10 min)
_docs.GH_TOKENS_ACCESS_TOKEN_INDEX: GSI name on the legacy GH tokens table. Kept for backward compatibility — no longer queried
_docs.GH_DEEP_LINK_BASE_URL: Base URL for the GH deep link shown to users on the consent page to open the Google Home app
_docs.GH_DEEP_LINK_PATH: Path component of the GH deep link above
_docs.GOOGLE_SA_KEY_SECRET_ARN: Legacy field for old-format SA key secret. Superseded by GH_SA_SECRET_ARN — leave blank
_docs.GH_SA_SECRET_ARN: Secrets Manager secret containing the Google service account JSON. Used by proactive reporting to authenticate Google Reports API calls
_docs.GH_SA_SECRET_REGION: Region of the GH service account secret
_docs.USER_DEVICE_DETAILS_TABLE: Existing DDB table with per-user device inventory. DDB stream on this table feeds alexa_proactive_discovery
_docs.USER_DEVICE_MAPPING_TABLE: Existing DDB table mapping users to devices. Used by alexa_fulfillment for device discovery queries
_docs.DEVICE_STATE_TABLE: Existing DDB table with current device state. DDB stream on this feeds alexa_state_reporter for real-time state updates
_docs.SCENE_TABLE: Existing DDB table for scenes. Used by alexa_fulfillment to include scenes in device discovery
_docs.SCENE_GSI_NAME: GSI name on SCENE_TABLE used to query scenes by user
_docs.METADATA_BUCKET: Existing S3 bucket for device metadata (icons, capability descriptors). alexa_fulfillment reads icons from here
_docs.ENDPOINT_KEY_SECRET_ARN: Secrets Manager secret with the Alexa endpoint application key. alexa_fulfillment uses this to verify incoming Alexa request signatures
_docs.ENDPOINT_KEY_REGION: Region of the endpoint key secret. Must be eu-west-1 to match alexa_fulfillment's region
_docs.DEVICE_MODEL: Device model string returned in Alexa discovery responses
_docs.CREATE_UPDATE_FN: Name of existing Lambda that updates site/device metadata. Invoked async by link/unlink Lambdas to toggle isAlexaEnabled / isGoogleEnabled per site
_docs.LWA_TOKEN_URL: Amazon LWA token endpoint. Used to exchange auth codes and refresh LWA access tokens
_docs.LWA_REVOKE_URL: Amazon LWA revoke endpoint. Called by alexa_app_to_app_unlink to revoke tokens on unlink
_docs.SKILL_ENABLEMENT_URL: SMAPI endpoint to programmatically enable the skill for the user. Called in Stage 2 (alexa_cognito_callback) after Cognito auth
_docs.ALEXA_GATEWAY_URL: Alexa Event Gateway. alexa_state_reporter and alexa_proactive_discovery POST state/discovery events here
_docs.IOT_DATA_ENDPOINT: AWS IoT Core data endpoint. alexa_fulfillment sends device control commands here via MQTT publish
_docs.DEVICE_TABLE_SECRET_ARN: Secrets Manager secret for decrypting encrypted fields in device_state and user_device_details tables
_docs.DEVICE_TABLE_SECRET_REGION: Region of the device table encryption secret
_docs.GH_OAUTH_TRANSACTIONS_TABLE: DDB table tracking in-flight GH OAuth state during the authorize → callback flow. TTL = TRANSACTION_TTL_SECONDS
_docs.TRANSACTION_TTL_SECONDS: TTL for GH OAuth transaction records (600 = 10 min)
_docs.TERMS_URL: URL to the EULA/Terms of Service PDF. Shown as a link on the GH OAuth consent page
_docs.BRAND_TITLE: Main heading on the GH OAuth consent page (e.g. 'Honeywell Buildings')
_docs.BRAND_SUBTITLE: Sub-heading on the GH OAuth consent page
_docs.PRIVACY_POLICY_URL: URL to privacy policy. Shown as a link on the GH OAuth consent page
_docs.CONSENT_PAGE_HEADING: H1 heading text on the GH consent form
_docs.CONSENT_NOTICE_TEXT: Explanatory text shown above the permissions list on the consent form
_docs.CONSENT_PERM_LABEL: Label above the permissions list on the consent form
_docs.CONSENT_PERMISSIONS: Comma-separated permission labels shown on the consent form (display only, not enforced by OAuth)
_docs.CONSENT_TRUST_TEXT: Trust reminder text shown at the bottom of the consent form
_docs.CONSENT_DENY_LABEL: Label for the Deny button on the consent form
_docs.CONSENT_ALLOW_LABEL: Label for the Allow button on the consent form
